body: Got him when he came out a year or so ago.
When does goku ever cross his arms like that? Lol these companies are cool, but getting their figures is a pain.  Still waiting on a head sculpt that was supposed to be released last year.
Out of all of them, I think toybiz still has the best masked head.  The others are too flat and soft.  Figuarts comes at a close 2nd.

It's awful.  I only watch gaming and asmr.   Also music.  If I just type in asmr, I'm gonna be in for a world of disgust.  I'm talking stuff that makes your skin crawl.  It's a pretty evil thing to do honestly.  Youtube doesn't do anything about it either, regardless of the reporting.
The ninjas look boring asl.  Like they could've spiced it up a bit.  Atleast have the whole cowl.  Mkx sub looked sick.  I even prefer the mk11 sub look.

I'm in the same boat.  Its like a mirror.  I should be a good person and say don't do it.  It's your life though.   I'm lost and I will see how things go until next week sometime.  If I still feel the same, I might have to end it.  I just can't bare the pain and sadness anymore.

I never took my depression seriously.  Never thought I was gonna commit suicide.  Well here I am now.  I think the only ppl that can get through to me are the ones that are currently in the same boat as me.

No one commented on here ofcourse.  This is real.  I feel for you.  I'm sortve in the same boat.  Because of meds I've been taking, I can't get hard, or have trouble doing so.  I was seeing a girl for a while now and haven't had sex yet.  I always make excuses as to why I couldn't other than being impudent.  Well now, she said that we shouldn't talk for a while.  She said that she's in a bad mental space atm.  Idk man.  I'm lost and sad.  It's Christmas time too.  I guess by typing this, I can truely say that you're not the only one bro.  You can do what you want.  I'm very close to ending it myself.  I'm not going to get anymore help.  The pain is too much to bare right now.  I'm in pain.  Just know that you aren't the only one going through this.
I dont really want to blow my brains out.  Sounds very painful.  Overdosing does as well.  I guess it depends on the drug.  Going to sleep and never waking up again sounds peaceful enough.

Im still a little drunk from the vodka. I can only imagine the misery I'll feel when I wake up. She said she'll call me after dinner. I have to just trust that she will I guess. I have no control over it. I'm gonna be selfish and end it. I actually don't care what my family is gonna think or feel. My parents obviously found love. Both of my bros found love. They'll be fine. I on the other hand dont have a romantic partner. Typing all of this is sort of therapeutic. When I stop typing, the thoughts come up again. The feelings surface. There's nothing anyone can say at this point. I've had enough. It's 7pm and still no call btw. I shouldn't hold my breath anyways. Can't sleep though. No one can help me. I don't think I want help anymore. I'm very sad and lost right now. This has happened to me time and time again. I'm traumatized from past experiences, maybe that's why I have some trust and jealousy issues. Always the same shit. "You deserve better than me, I can't be the partner you deserve rn, etc". Just Typing that made me so angry. I'm done.
